checks: Actual mobile template creation fixes owner, dates and exact revision and initializes real tasks, milestones and logical folders once.
Draft editing uses the actual project version and explicit date clearing without changing owner, classification or selected template.
A real committed update with a lost browser response blocks resubmission and explicit reread reconciles its actual result.
Concurrent edits preserve unsubmitted text and block stale writes; active project scope and dates are read-only and absent from ordinary updates.
Actual member role changes and removal use exact versions, identities and reasons, then reload authoritative membership.
Owner handover uses a distinct command, returns the actual new owner and retains the former owner as manager.
Membership restriction invalidates the old login; a fresh real MFA viewer session has no editing, membership or deep-link write form.
